Silhouette: Upright two-legged emperor penguin frame. Host frame: the emperor penguin sets the outline, body size and overall frame. A single creature combining an emperor penguin and a cheetah. The head is that of the emperor penguin, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: emperor penguin body and legs, with its own layered contour feathers on the face, neck, shoulders, belly, hips, legs and tail in a plain coat with no stripes or spots; from the cheetah, as parts and materials on the emperor penguin's own body, dense fur in its own colors grown from the skin as the emperor penguin's own covering over the back and flanks, replacing the emperor penguin's layered contour feathers there and conforming to the emperor penguin's body, sized to the emperor penguin's body and following its contours; every covered part keeps the emperor penguin's own length and shape; the layered contour feathers stop at the covering's edge, and the face, neck, shoulders, belly, hips, legs and tail keep the emperor penguin's own layered contour feathers; cheetah-type spots on the covering. The covering follows the body's own shape. Bilaterally symmetrical, with recognizable limbs and visible sense organs. Habitat cue (alpine meadow): shorter ears and tail, dense coat for the cold. Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.

summary.text:
**Designing hybrid creature concept**
I'm planning a single upright creature with an emperor penguin silhouette and head, then layering dense cheetah-colored fur over the penguin's body and limbs while keeping the face clear and uncluttered.
**Drafting natural history illustration**
I'm assembling a side three-quarter, full-body natural history plate of the hybrid: penguin head, beak, and feathered front with furred, cheetah-spotted back and flanks, set on a plain light background with alpine cues and natural lighting.
**Refining mermaid illustration**
I'm adjusting the mermaid to a full-body, side three-quarter view with visible feet, removing the fin and wings so only legs appear, and preparing a new version that matches the requested anatomy.
